scope: VowVault reservation claim route and logged-out public receipt verifier

liveReadOnly.transactionScope: Real successful mainnet negative control; unrelated to VOW

coverage: Reservation data and pinned classes are read before wallet preparation or supplier signature input is enabled

ReservationClaimed keys and data match the compiled VowVault ABI

limitations: The pinned VowVault address is explicitly marked not deployed, and its collection controls remain disabled
Positive receipt and wallet paths use synthetic test data
The live rejection is a single-provider public observation, not VOW execution evidence
No note ownership, proof validity, VowVault deployment or supplier collection is verified
